subject: Foundry Labs - welcome package grace request
messages:
From: Andrew Kim <andrew@foundrylabs.io>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2025-06-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: welcome package grace for pilot billing

Hi Laura,

Quick one — we started our pilot last week and onboarding traffic spiked because our integration sent duplicate inference jobs overnight. That exhausted the welcome credits on day 3. We're a small team and that spike was an accident; can you help us with a one-time make-good so we can finish the evaluation and keep momentum with internal stakeholders?

Specifically: would Redwood consider adding a top-up to our welcome package or extending the trial window by two weeks? We're evaluating Dedicated capacity and this demo week is critical.

Thanks — appreciate any flexibility.

Andrew Kim
Head of Platform
Foundry Labs
andrew@foundrylabs.io
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-2198

-----

(ops@foundrylabs.io cc'd for billing coordination)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sales@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2025-06-12T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: welcome package grace for pilot billing

Ben / Marissa — forwarding a request from Foundry Labs. They burned through welcome credits due to an integration error and are asking for either a one-time top-up or a trial extension.

Details: company seems engaged, likely < $25k ARR potential in first year but runway for Dedicated conversation depends on smooth eval. They called out a demo week next week and want to keep momentum.

My ask: can we approve a limited make-good under a controlled exception? Proposed options:
- Option A: one-time top-up of 40,000 token-equivalent trial credit (no rollover) + 14-day extension to the trial window
- Option B: 60,000 token top-up but require a short mutual action plan and 30% commitment to a POC outcome (convert to reserved capacity if they hit X usage)

Need approval on the dollar equivalence we can absorb, and whether we need legal/accounting sign-off for invoice changes. If approved, I'll reply to Andrew with an official make-good and attach an amended invoice + MAP draft.

Laura Bennett
Senior Sales Manager, Startup Programs
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

> On 2025-06-12 09:12, Andrew Kim <andrew@foundrylabs.io> wrote:
> > Quick one — we started our pilot last week and onboarding traffic spiked because our integration sent duplicate inference jobs overnight...

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: finance@redwoodinference.com, legal@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2025-06-12T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: welcome package grace for pilot billing

Laura — thanks for the context. I support a limited exception with constraints. Recommend:
1) Approve Option A (40k token top-up + 14-day extension). Keeps our cost exposure manageable and buys them the demo runway.
2) Add two conditions: (a) CS to validate fix of integration spike within 48 hours; (b) Foundry signs the MAP acknowledging the trial extension and a mutual conversion review at the end of the extension.
3) Finance: treat the top-up as promotional credits (expense) and note in the invoice as a 1-line promotional adjustment — no change to recognized revenue. Legal: no contract amendment needed for this one-off, but collect an email confirmation agreeing to the MAP terms.

If that's acceptable I'll approve and Laura can send the formal reply and amended invoice. Marking deal_id FDY-2025-0892.

Ben Carter
Head of Startup Sales
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com

> On 2025-06-12 09:34, Laura Bennett wrote:
> > My ask: can we approve a limited make-good under a controlled exception?

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Andrew Kim <andrew@foundrylabs.io>
Cc: ops@foundrylabs.io, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2025-06-12T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: welcome package grace for pilot billing

Hi Andrew — thanks for flagging and for the details. We can make a one-time accommodation to help you finish the evaluation.

What we'll provide today:
- A one-time credit top-up equivalent to 40,000 tokens applied to your account immediately (shown as a promotional adjustment on the attached amended invoice).
- A 14-calendar-day extension to your welcome/trial window starting today.

Conditions:
1) Our Customer Success team (Marissa copied) will schedule a quick sync to confirm the duplicate-job root cause and validate the fix within 48 hours.
2) Please sign the attached mutual action plan (MAP) in the Drive link so we have alignment on success criteria and a conversion review at the end of the extension.

Attachments: amended-invoice-FOUND-20250612.pdf, Foundry-MAP-draft.docx
Related link: https://drive.redwoodinference.com/s/Foundry-MAP-Draft

If that works, reply to this thread and we'll mark the account and update the invoice. If you need a larger top-up we can discuss Option B but would need a short conversion commitment.

Best,

Laura Bennett
Senior Sales Manager, Startup Programs
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
